transcript: Listen, I moved from Fort Lauderdale for two reasons. Both of them are national news. National! The first one is my kids daycare got in trouble for hosting a toddler fight club. Which is horrible! I just lost 150 bucks. My daughter told me the other day, she's like, Mommy, you're an attorney. You should really give your money to people who are poorer and less fortunate than you. I know. I was like, I already do that. It's called alimony. Because I'm also a Russian Jew and for some reason I look like Mexican Alanis Morrison.
